d: Bihar ke motihari (purvi chanparan) jile ke dhaka thana kshetr antargat karashiya ganv se rishton ko jhakjhor dene vali ek sanasnikhej vardat samne aaee hai. yahan ek sanki pati ne apne sasural pahunchkar apni hi patni ko paisa aur mobail phon dene ka lalach dekar sunsan jagah par bulaya aur uski berahmi se hatya kar shav ko gaddhe men gar diya. pulis ne tvarit karravaee karte hue aaropi pati ko giraphtar kar uski nishandehi par shav baramad kar liya hai.
